# Synthetic engine output for tests/test_push.py: two gauges named as SGLang
# names them (a colon after the prefix), and one whose `pool` label clashes
# with the node identity label of the same name.
# HELP sglang:num_running_reqs The number of running requests.
# TYPE sglang:num_running_reqs gauge
sglang:num_running_reqs{model_name="test-model"} 2.0
# HELP sglang:num_queue_reqs The number of requests in the waiting queue.
# TYPE sglang:num_queue_reqs gauge
sglang:num_queue_reqs{model_name="test-model"} 0.0
# HELP sglang:test_pool_usage A series with a pool label of its own.
# TYPE sglang:test_pool_usage gauge
sglang:test_pool_usage{model_name="test-model",pool="kv"} 0.25
sglang:test_pool_usage{model_name="test-model",pool="swa"} 0.5
